description: Cross-binding conformance for the CANDIDATE-GATED pathway of regridding/conservative_overlap.esm with GENUINE broad-phase pruning: two disjoint cell clusters ten degrees apart (cluster A: source [0,1]+[1,2] -> target [0,2]; cluster B: source [10,11]+[11,12] -> target [10,12]; all x [0,1] in lat, planar manifold). With bin_dx = bin_dy = 4.0 and bbox-min representatives (derived in-library by the reduce-min templates), cluster A quantizes to floor bin 0 and cluster B to bin 2, so the bin-Skolem equi-join admits only the 4 same-cluster pairs and prunes the 4 cross-cluster pairs -- the candidate set is a PROPER SUBSET of the cross product, unlike the degenerate-safe sibling conservative_overlap_gated_3x3_to_2x2. The binning is admissible (pruned pairs have zero true overlap), so the dense path computed side by side reaches the identical surviving set and the inline gated_equals_dense test asserts the total A_ij/A_j/W_ij L1 residual is 0.0 at tolerance abs 0.0. Hand-exact expectations (non-golden): A_ij = 1.0 deg^2 on the four surviving pairs (source cells nest exactly in their cluster's target), 0 elsewhere; A_j = 2.0 both targets; W_ij = 1/2 on surviving pairs; F_tgt = [1.5, 3.5] with F_src = [1..4]; both masses 10. Exact 5.8.3 invariant gates (partition-of-unity, conservation) plus the committed golden per-pair weights from the official Julia runner (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh, BuildInspection setup arrays).

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no aggregate lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no aggregate lowering / simulator

tolerances._doc: Same 5.8 contract as the other planar regridding cases: sliver floor atol = area_atol_factor * characteristic_length^2; partition-of-unity exact by construction; conservation exact because each target tiles its cluster's source cells. The gated-vs-dense value identity is gated in-fixture at abs 0.0.

reference_weights._doc: NON-GOLDEN hand-derived values for eyeball checking (derivation in the description). Triples are [i, j, value], 1-based; pairs not listed are exactly 0 (cross-cluster pairs are PRUNED by the broad phase and zero-overlap in the dense path).
reference_weights.candidate_pairs: 4 of 8 possible pairs: {(1,1),(2,1),(3,2),(4,2)} -- bins ('bin',0,0) for cluster A, ('bin',2,0) for cluster B
